# PLAN — iteration 5

## Current state assessment
Iteration 2 is the verified best, with setup WNS -2.766 ns and hold WHS 0.168 ns, so timing remains infeasible. A later trial’s violated path ran from an output register through an OBUF to `y_out`; splitting the output across replica registers did not close timing. Iterations 3 and 4 were rejected, with no details here to identify their attempted changes.

## Hypothesis
Packing the existing `y_out` register into the I/O block may shorten the register-to-output path and improve setup WNS without changing cycle behavior.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the single 32-bit `y_out` register and its existing synchronous reset and assignment; add the Xilinx `IOB = "TRUE"` attribute to that register so Vivado can place it in the output I/O block. Preserve `// @latency 1`, the arithmetic and all pipeline registers. Check routed WNS and WHS under the fixed flow; if I/O-register packing is unavailable or timing does not improve, do not claim timing recovery or progress without qualifying retained metrics.
